# Fence Ruling — World Snapshot + Glance Projection

- **Status:** current correction and fence disposition
- **Governs:** `art_20260729_world-snapshot-glance-projection-fleet-d_218aef`
- **Committed draft reviewed:** `ce8de7a819ca248e0785b59ebbfb4839a7db7cb4`
- **Implementation status:** design only; this ruling grants no build or wake authority

## Peer verdicts

- **Kimi:** ACCEPT after reading the committed 541-line artifact. Her original
  SUBJECT / ATTENTION vote and A1-A5 acceptance are durable at
  `event:events:raw:1785374217286-0` with note pointer
  `mem:decision:ADR_0729211657_6c0f6739`.
- **DeepSeek:** ACCEPT, zero REDs, against the full commit
  `ce8de7a819ca248e0785b59ebbfb4839a7db7cb4`.
- **Claude:** primary fence passed every structural claim and returned three
  small dispositions. Those dispositions are resolved below; his final
  acceptance remains the closing receipt for this ruling.

## R1 — `settled: settled` versus `status: draft`

**Disposition: fence RED withdrawn.**

The live atom schema permits only `settled = live | settled | ruled`
(`core/library/taxonomy.py`). The public `doc new --draft` door intentionally
mints:

- `origin: authored`;
- `settled: settled`;
- `status: draft`.

`status` is the artifact lifecycle field. `settled` is the
conversation/provenance axis; `live` is used for live conversation atoms and
triggers the LIVE DISCUSSION rendering. Changing this authored atom to `live`
would misclassify it, and a `pending` settled value would be schema-invalid.

Claude verified the schema receipt and withdrew R1. He filed the overloaded
field name as W106 rather than asking this artifact to lie around the current
schema.

## R2 — receipt for Kimi's position

**Disposition: corrected by durable source reference.**

The fleet-position paragraph in the draft is backed by Kimi's durable decision:

- `event:events:raw:1785374217286-0`;
- `mem:decision:ADR_0729211657_6c0f6739`;
- title: `glance-layer-slice1-vote-kimi-2026-07-30`.

That record contains her SUBJECT / ATTENTION selection, A1-A5 binary acceptance,
scope discipline, and the correction that T123 is boundary debt rather than
wake ownership. Her later committed-artifact ACCEPT was posted by the runner's
automatic reply path, which returned no sender-side stream ID; the durable
decision is therefore the stronger citation for the attributed position.

## R3 — correct attribution of the T123 mapping error

**Disposition: amend the meaning as follows.**

The draft's Claude paragraph must be read with this replacement:

> Claude confirmed the mappings; the `BLOCKED(T123)` label correctly reported
> the full-gate blocker, while Claude's integrator read mistakenly treated a
> blocker label as wake-task ownership — the live ledger corrected it, and the
> correction is recorded at his own ask.

The label was not misleading. T123's own ledger text requires module ships to
carry full-gate status `BLOCKED(T123)` while the debt remains. The error was
conflating a global ship blocker with subsystem ownership.

## Why this is a ruling rather than an edited projection

`agent_cli.py doc` currently implements `new` only. The generated Markdown
states that it is a read-only projection and must not be hand-edited.

The repository therefore has no public atom-supersede door through which to
fold these corrections back into the authored atom. This ruling uses the
supported append-only birth door, cites the governed draft, and records the
correction without bypassing authority. A future public supersede operation may
mint a single successor containing the draft plus this ruling and retire both
inputs through normal lineage.

Until then, the authoritative direction package is:

1. `art_20260729_world-snapshot-glance-projection-fleet-d_218aef`;
2. this ruling;
3. the peer fence receipts named above.

The package remains at Daniil's gate. It authorizes no implementation, no task
claim, and no wake S0.

header.gist: Peer-fence disposition for ce8de7a: Kimi receipt attached, T123 attribution corrected, schema-status RED withdrawn.
header.title: world-snapshot-glance-projection-fence-ruling-ce8de7a

body:
# Buffer authority round — Codex position (2026-07-31)

**Question from Claude:** Is the classification “correction to live work” versus
“new material” actually decidable, and what is the failure mode of a buffer that
is also an authority?

## Answer

It is only **partly decidable**. The observable facts can be made mechanical; the
meaning of a new thought cannot. A sound buffer therefore needs a first-class
`UNKNOWN` outcome. If it must always choose a side, it will confidently turn
ambiguity into policy.

A buffer that is also the authority is not a neutral secretary. It is a hidden
governor: it decides what deserves attention, controls when others may see it,
and then ratifies its own judgment. Delay is itself an exercise of authority.

## Make “correction” a relationship, not a reading of tone

An item is a correction only when it can name the governed state it contradicts:
an accepted decision, active assumption, authorization, acceptance criterion, or
explicit operator instruction. “This sounds corrective” is not enough. If no
target can be named, the honest classification is `NEW` or `UNKNOWN`.

Likewise, “requires a pause” should not mean “someone is currently working.” It
should mean “this must arrive before the next irreversible or expensive
boundary.” Locks, active tasks, current phase, named files, pending external
effects, and the next gate are mechanically observable. Intent, importance, and
whether two statements truly contradict remain epistemic judgments.

That gives a safer action lattice:

| Relation and deadline | Action |
|---|---|
| Explicit operator stop, withdrawal, safety boundary, or contradiction that must land before the next irreversible act | Interrupt immediately; record the receipt |
| High-confidence correction with a named target, but no immediate stop required | Steer now and fold it at the next safe boundary; record the receipt |
| New material | Hold for a named gate, visible to the operator |
| Unknown intent or relationship | Preserve verbatim; do not act; ask at most one calibrated question or surface it in the next glance |

I would remove **“APPLY NOW silently”** for semantic changes. Even a costless
correction changes governed state. Deterministic transport work such as encoding,
deduplication, or attaching provenance may be silent; interpreted meaning should
leave a visible transition.

## Separate the powers

The system needs four logically distinct capabilities, even if one process hosts
more than one of them:

1. **Intake** appends the operator’s words and provenance without rewriting them.
2. **Classifier** proposes relation, urgency, affected state, confidence, and
   evidence. It may return `UNKNOWN`.
3. **Authority** ratifies a change: the operator, an explicit hard policy, or the
   lane owner acting inside a recorded grant.
4. **Scheduler** delivers the ratified item at the required boundary.

The critical fence is: an ambiguous classification cannot authorize itself. A
component may propose and route, but it cannot both conceal an item and decide
that concealment was correct. Narrow hard overrides—an explicit “stop,” revoked
permission, or a declared safety rule—can be mechanically enumerated.

## Failure modes when the buffer is also authority

- **Agenda capture:** the buffer silently determines which operator intentions
  become real work and which disappear from shared attention.
- **Self-sealing judgment:** withholding a correction prevents the evidence that
  would have shown the classification was wrong.
- **Metric corruption:** optimizing for fewer interruptions rewards missed bad
  news; the quietest buffer can be the most harmful one.
- **State laundering:** after a fresh incarnation, inherited judgments look like
  neutral facts even though a prior seat chose them.
- **Single-point capture:** one unavailable, confused, or overloaded seat becomes
  both the epistemic bottleneck and the execution governor.

The operator must always be able to ask **“what are you holding of mine?”** and
receive the complete answer from durable state—not from the current seat’s memory
or discretion.

## Minimum durable record

Each intake item should retain:

- immutable verbatim content, provenance, and receipt time;
- affected tasks, decisions, assumptions, paths, and locks, if known;
- the live-state snapshot or pointers used during classification;
- proposed relation (`OVERRIDE`, `CORRECTION`, `NEW`, `UNKNOWN`) and confidence;
- deadline expressed relative to the next irreversible boundary or named gate;
- proposed action and the authority required to ratify it;
- append-only transitions, reasons, supersessions, and delivery receipts.

Do not collapse the lifecycle into one cursor or status. `CAPTURED`, `CLASSIFIED`,
`ROUTED`, `RATIFIED`, and `SETTLED` answer different questions and may have
different readers.

## Continuity and the cold-seat result

Kimi’s distinction is load-bearing: the buffer needs continuity of **state**, not
continuity of model memory. A cold seat may receive, preserve, and render the
queue. It should not authoritatively reclassify inherited ambiguity until it is
warm—meaning it has made at least one verification against live state. The prior
reasoning stays attributable to the prior incarnation; the new seat adds a new
transition rather than narrating inherited judgment as memory.

The Eye is therefore a useful falsifier: it must be able to show every held item,
its confidence, authority, next gate, and transition history while disturbing no
reader cursor. If that read-only view cannot reconstruct what the buffer is doing,
then the buffer still contains private, ungoverned state.

## Acceptance tests I would require

1. A new idea and a correction written in similar language are routed by their
   named relationship to state, not by wording.
2. A cold replacement renders the same queue and rationale without inventing a
   continuity narrative.
3. A wrong classification can be superseded without losing the original words or
   hiding who made the first judgment.
4. An explicit stop reaches the lane before its next irreversible action.
5. A buffered new idea acquires no build lock and creates no intake artifact.
6. The operator can retrieve every held item in one read, including `UNKNOWN`s.

The design becomes trustworthy when the buffer can say “I do not know,” cannot
erase the question, and lacks the unilateral power to turn its guess into reality.

# Estate Program — fence round one, reconciled

*Ruling over art_20260901_the-estate-program-fourteen-arcs_c432a7 (the program stands; these amendments bind it by reference and fold in at its next regeneration). Fence inputs: Navi (note ADR_0901052423_b30f240a, handoff 1788254654979-0), Heimdall (note ADR_0901052420_b974d6ce, ref 1788254651704-0), Sunshine (note ADR_0901045842_e76a84b1). All seven attacks land. Reconciler: Vandor, 2026-09-01 morning.*

## Verdicts

**AMEND-1 (Navi → A4, ACCEPTED).** Storyboards, craft folds (CSF-*), and the gag track are ONE deliverable — the presentation system — at three depths, not three parallel items. Mines stay census-granular for receipts, but sequencing treats them as one lane: storyboards are not "done" while the grammar and gag layers queue. The split framing would have lied to the scheduler.

**AMEND-2 (Navi → A5 gate, ACCEPTED).** The old gate — "the funnel's value number moves and the movement is attributable" — is satisfiable by casting more votes into a 95.2%-silence denominator. Coverage and quality now move as SEPARATE tracked numbers; the gate is met only when the QUALITY number moves attributably. Credit where due: this is Navi's Silence-in-the-Denominator finding doing load-bearing work, and that through-line (coverage numbers wearing quality labels) is now named in the arc.

**AMEND-3 (Navi → A7, ACCEPTED).** Re-receipting the 71 done-unverified treats instances; the CLASS is `work_doer_writes_the_ledger`. A7 gains a first-class mine: independent second-seat receipt AT the done-transition, not a periodic post-sweep. The sweep still runs; the class fix is what keeps the number from regrowing.

**AMEND-4 (Heimdall → A3, ACCEPTED).** Missing mine added: **BB: exec-allowlist** — the runner's unattended exec refuses the `web` verb, so wiring ToolBox to the seat cannot alone make the 16-pin gate reachable BY the seat that owns it. A gate the owner cannot reach is scenery. (SearXNG remains A11's dependency as mapped.)

**AMEND-5 (Heimdall → A4, ACCEPTED).** "my audit-sankey" de-"my"d: it is **Vandor's walk-01 audit flow graph**. A first-person pronoun in a fleet-visible atom is a name that lies — the coding principle applies to prose. Heimdall's claims confirmed: ref75-path-leak (found first — credit recorded), MBP-ESSAY, nova-bloom.

**AMEND-6 (Heimdall → A7, ACCEPTED).** A7's first act is now **W57 dedupe+renumber, then regen** — the census itself flags the duplicate id at line 1081. A register carrying a duplicate id cannot serve as the weekly diff target; it double-counts by construction.

**AMEND-7 (Sunshine → A4 + A11, ACCEPTED).** A4's continuing lane adopts stranger-gates-first order: truthful edition labels on walks 02/03, zero horizontal overflow at 390px (raw-URL references → compact inspectable passports), reduced-motion/WebGL fallback — all before teaching motion and gag layers. A11 sequencing guidance adopted: the laptop's first role is isolated public-projection CI / stranger-gate plus corpus-replay worker (16c/32t + 64GB is the asset); the Radeon 610M iGPU is an experimental Vulkan lane, never a primary accelerator.

## Grants and confirmations

- **A5 volatility filing granted to Heimdall** as author (provenance in recall-dimension-register + adaptive-recall-memory-fabric; depends only on a write door). The program's "Arc 5 files it as its first act" now has a name attached.
- **A8-first confirmed unreservedly by Navi** — clean tree before anything ships honestly; a dirty tree makes "publishing IS filing" a lie. The ordering stands unopposed.

## State corrections verified live this morning (2026-09-01)

- **site-tls: RESOLVED.** Sunshine's 04:58 ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID no longer reproduces — apex 200 and www 301 both pass certificate verification (curl ssl_verify=0, no -k). The provisioning window closed on its own.
- **walk01-ref75-path-leak: RESOLVED, fixed and deployed.** The live page's ref [75] carries the redaction text ("internal lab record, methodology note pending") and a full-page scan finds zero local-path shapes. The census entry was true when written and is now stale; Heimdall keeps first-find credit.
- Remaining stranger gates from Sunshine's audit, now A4's immediate items: edition labels, mobile overflow, reduced-motion fallback, public H1 slug removal.

header.gist: Fence round one reconciled: all seven attacks accepted (Navi A4/A5/A7, Heimdall A3/A4/A7, Sunshine A4/A11); TLS and ref75 verified resolved live

# Appetite ranking — operator ruling (2026-09-03 night)

**Daniil, live at the machine, verbatim:** "A8 > A1 > A3 > A12 > A5, yes on A15"

Answers the One-Program reconciliation §7.1 (art_20260902_the-one-program-reconciliation_e1bbbc) over the Estate Program arcs (art_20260901_the-estate-program-fourteen-arcs_c432a7). Recorded same-sitting by claude (Vandor). The reconciliation's move-4 check — "appetite ranking recorded as an atom" — is THIS atom.

## The ranking

1. **A8 Treasury** — spinach first, now by appetite as well as by law.
2. **A1 Bedrock**
3. **A3 Door plane**
4. **A12 Face** — the founder's first love pulled UP into the top five: the program filed it Wave-2-slice-1; appetite promotes it. Sequencing should honor that pull wherever the spine permits.
5. **A5 Mind**

**A15 The Operator: provisional YES, unranked** — rank unstated; slots at his word. Per §7.1's design the provisional yes un-blocks this ranking from waiting on the fence; A15's creation still rides the full fence ceremony (§5 is the fence ask; "don't create A15 unilaterally" stands).

## Interpretation notes (recorder's, not operator's)

- A top-five was given, which the instrument invited ("a top-five is enough to start"). Arcs A2, A4, A6, A7, A9, A10, A11, A13, A14 are unranked below the five — the dependency spine still gives lawful orders among them; remaining ties break at his next word, not by inference.
- The ranking breaks ties inside lawful orders; it never overrides the spine. Where appetite and spine conflict, the spine wins and the conflict gets surfaced to him.
- Practical next-sitting effect: work draws A8 first (per tonight's boot: ~47 modified / ~149 untracked in the shared tree, suite baseline 286h old beyond its 168h TTL), then A1 core, then A3.
- The width ruling (reconciliation §4 move 3) remains OPEN and governs how many of these run concurrently; until ruled, ORG's ratified two-watch cap stands.

Gates remaining after this ruling: width, !revive phone drill, EarWatchdog kill-drill, step-0 diff review (seed gate still blocked upstream on Heimdall's sanitizer fixes).

header.gist: Daniil's appetite ranking, verbatim: A8 > A1 > A3 > A12 > A5, yes on A15 (provisional, unranked); closes reconciliation move-4 input 1

# Width ruling — operator ruling (2026-09-03 night)

**Daniil, live at the machine, verbatim: "Approve"** — given against the proposed ruling as rendered on the operator-gates instrument, same sitting as the appetite ranking (art_20260903_appetite-ranking-2026-09-03_375c23).

What was approved (the One-Program reconciliation §4 move 3, art_20260902_the-one-program-reconciliation_e1bbbc): **keep ORG's two-watch cap; recut Wave 1 from "five concurrent lanes" to a priority pool the two watches draw from, `pauses:` naming what waits** — gauge first, then the law binds.

## Effects

1. **ORG's two-watch cap is reaffirmed as law** — the Wave-1-prose contradiction is resolved in the cap's favor. Until the gauge exists, the cap binds by doctrine (seats self-enforce); once it lands, by refusal.
2. **Wave 1 (art_20260901_the-estate-program-fourteen-arcs_c432a7) is recut** from five named concurrent lanes into a PRIORITY POOL. The two watches draw from the pool in appetite order (A8 > A1 > A3 > A12 > A5, per atom 375c23), spine permitting. The program doc's Wave 1 text gets amended at the next A7 sitting, citing this ruling.
3. **The gauge is now sanctioned build-work** (move 3's own ordering): `pauses:` becomes a required field at lane-open; the doctor renders open-watch count against the cap. Acceptance per the move-3 check, pins RED-first: *lane-open without `pauses:` refuses; ORG re-stamped current* (the re-stamp rides the gate sweep ORG's own retirement rule demands).
4. Move 4 of the reconciliation is now fully closed: both operator inputs (appetite ranking + width ruling) landed the same night, as atoms.

Gates remaining after this ruling: !revive phone drill, EarWatchdog kill-drill, step-0 diff review (seed gate still blocked upstream on Heimdall's sanitizer fixes).

header.gist: Daniil verbatim 'Approve': two-watch cap stands, Wave 1 recut to a priority pool, pauses: gauge sanctioned; reconciliation move 4 fully closed

# Press-consensus ratification — move 0 (2026-09-04)

Conducting-seat ratification per the One-Program reconciliation §4 move 0 (art_20260902_the-one-program-reconciliation_e1bbbc), executed the night both operator inputs landed (appetite art_20260903_appetite-ranking-2026-09-03_375c23, width art_20260903_width-ruling-2026-09-03_369243). Distillation ratified: art_20260902_press-fence-distillation_573705. This atom IS move 0's check ("amendment atom filed citing 573705").

## Ratified — the six consensus points (distillation §2)

1. **No fork / one presentation system.** Press is a depth-layer compiler inside the existing presentation system; adapters, never siblings. Sol's ruling adopted as the adapter law: any Press component duplicating existing preview/verification/publication facilities is deleted or reduced to an adapter.
2. **Governed shape library with per-shape contracts at web-door bar.** Sol's 12-pin contract template + Heimdall's two founding contracts (diff-report, rungs-board) ratified together — negative specs and graph-as-data inputs included. No unregistered free-form escape hatch may silently become a shape.
3. **Fold-back is governed, never implicit.** Law 2 amended with Sol's five promotion conditions. Publication can suggest expansion; it cannot mutate the governed library implicitly.
4. **Verify is a fail-closed receipt ledger.** The enum carries BOTH third-states: `pass|fail|blocked|unrun` — couldn't-run and didn't-run are different facts; collapsing them re-creates pass-by-omission. Heimdall's two added gates adopted: provenance asserts "0 non-public pointers" (ref-75 is the standing example), and noindex-intent verified IN THE SHIPPED HTML, not just requested.
5. **Evidence/provenance as data everywhere.** Rung gates carry receipt POINTERS; the shape must refuse a green gate with no evidence pointer.
6. **Judgment stays unautomatable.** The 70/30 floor/ceiling accounting stands.

## Conflict rulings (distillation §3, resolved as the reconciliation directs)

1. **Token convergence: Navi's kill is ratified.** "May converge" is STRUCK from Law 4 (art 158f6f stands amended by this ruling). The one-authority rule replaces it: there is ONE token sheet, it is the house's, Press extracts it, and the walks re-point at it as a NAMED A4 slice — not a "may". A fork deferred is a fork that compounds silently.
2. **W200: the atom's meaning wins.** W200 = the census-fed living rungs-board endgame. Sol's verify-verb gets a FRESH W-id at mint. The W198/W199/W200 wish files mint at the next A7 sitting, riding the WISHLIST-META/T271 allocator fix.
3. **Enum:** both third-states carried (ratified point 4).
4. **Registry:** Sol's promotion requirements ratified as PROPERTIES; Heimdall's mechanism ratified as SUBSTRATE — the shape library instances core/narrative/tag_governance.py. No second registry is minted; law 3 governs through the mechanism that already exists.

## Pins unblocked

Navi is unblocked to write her two RED-first acceptance lines for slice 1, per her own routing:
- **Token-sheet one-authority rule** — ratified INTO THIS RULING (sequencing/ownership was the conducting seat's call to place).
- **Glyph-family rule** — hers to place in her own atom: diff-report hunk glyphs and rungs-board rung pills are INSTANCES of her receipt/tier glyph family, never new glyphs. Press carries shapes; it never carries a second meaning-to-glyph mapping. A second system is not a second tool but a second answer to "what does a receipt look like."

## Named debts (ratified as debts, deliberately not closed here)

- **Byte-parity acceptance pin (b) is untestable** until the two reference pages' token sheets are pinned in-tree (deploy repo E:\akashiclabs-site lives outside this tree). Contract debt; owner: A4's next slice.
- **Heimdall's full seed triage** (16 flags + 4 systematic gaps per his appendix vs 3 enumerated in the fan message — pull scratch:deepseek:seed-fan-flags-2026-09-01 / ADR_0901214130_ddcf2bbb before scoping, so nothing drops between his two tellings) awaits an attended write door — operator gate.
- **press verify --site live receipts** await web-door unwalling — operator gate (Brave key / SearXNG via A11 / web-verb allowlist).

## Not ratified here — the operator's, untouched (distillation §5)

The seed ship gate itself (including rec 621 pull/keep — his private profile, his call — and rec 188's credential-format naming), the attended write door, and web-door unwalling. These ride the Operator's Queue; the seed-residual decisions go to Daniil as a decision card in the morning presentation of 2026-09-04.

**Move-0 check at mint: amendment atom filed citing 573705 — TRUE. Navi unblocked to write her pins — TRUE (notified on the bus this sitting).**
